summary: Prevent identity fields from matching bottleneck queries

delivery.outcome: Remove identity-only false positives from operational multi-term bottleneck graphs.
nonGoals: Do not change single-string query behavior.
Do not add discovery authority, dependencies or remediation decisions.

architecture.decision: For list queries, match entity operational attributes excluding identity keys; retain full node matching for string queries.
architecture.rollback: Restore full-node matching for list queries.

validation.evidence: Regression fixture and live installed CLI fleet + PR canary exclude repository-name false positives.
